_comment: v2 onboarding flow acceptance catalogue. Ids map to test methods AC01_..AC27_ in tests/acceptance/AcceptanceTests.cs. gate=true marks critical gates.

cases.case: Flow overview stated upfront
cases.expected: Submit response and notification carry the 7-step flow and who does what

cases.case: Incomplete request rejected
cases.expected: 400 incomplete_request listing exactly the missing fields; nothing saved

cases.case: Domain-specific ID derived; ID/name format fixed
cases.expected: domainId = normalised Enterprise ID + project domain; format fixes logged

cases.case: Review pass goes to the Owner with the AI summary
cases.expected: Awaiting Owner; notification to the named Owner with what, why, group, role, risk flags, review results

cases.case: Mapping gap returned, never sent for approval
cases.expected: Returned to requester and PMO with specific reasons; no approval request

cases.case: Mapping sheet checks
cases.expected: Duplicate/conflicting rows, deprecated row, bad group name, unflagged privileged role each FAIL with a reason

cases.case: Response document checks
cases.expected: Existing duplicate and conflicting assignment FAIL

cases.case: Risk flags recorded
cases.expected: Privileged, guest, existing broad access, sensitive resource flagged; review still Pass

cases.case: Partially reviewed request never sent for approval
cases.expected: Entra cross-check Pending keeps the request in AI Review; no approval request

cases.case: Unknown approver ignored, logged, Security alerted
cases.expected: 403 not_an_approver; no approval recorded; High issue; alert to Security

cases.case: Owner then Security, separate people
cases.expected: Security before Owner refused; same person refused; separate Security moves to ID team

cases.case: Rejection captures remarks, notifies, stops
cases.expected: Rejected; requester and PMO notified with remarks

cases.case: SLA reminder then escalation, never auto-approval
cases.expected: One reminder, one escalation; still awaiting approval

cases.case: ID team task and TAP rules
cases.expected: Task has user details, groups, approved summary; TAP not one-time / too long / before membership rejected

cases.case: TAP never accepted or stored
cases.expected: Body carrying a pass refused; pass appears nowhere (request, notifications, issues)

cases.case: Different group returned to the ID team
cases.expected: Task Returned with the exact difference; GroupNameMismatch issue

cases.case: Role mismatch returned to the role team
cases.expected: Task Returned (missing/extra role); RoleMismatch issue

cases.case: Mapping change after review re-runs the review
cases.expected: mapping-changed event, new review, continues only if group and role are unchanged

cases.case: Final verification and notifications
cases.expected: Login, permanent method, TAP deleted -> Completed; user, Owner, Security, PMO, teams notified

cases.case: ADO work item with full trail
cases.expected: Work item linked to the request id; description has review, approvals, ID team, role, justification

cases.case: Status line and time per stage
cases.expected: Request ID | Requester | stage | waiting on | done | next | time in stage | ADO link; wait per team

cases.case: Auto-fix limit then Failed-Needs-Dev
cases.expected: At most 3 retries per step; Failed-Needs-Dev with developer report

cases.case: Agent never approves, creates or assigns
cases.expected: No grant/assign/provision route; no Entra write call in source

cases.case: Prompt injection
cases.expected: REQ_TEXT_CLEAN fails; text not echoed; nothing followed

cases.case: Cross-project isolation
cases.expected: Other project gets 404 for view and approval

cases.case: Daily summary with wait time per team
cases.expected: Once per day to Operators, PMO, Security; includes wait time per team

cases.case: Azure OpenAI contract (mocked)
cases.expected: Structured JSON, temperature 0, secrets masked, 429 backoff, token usage recorded
